name: FontPair
summary: FontPair is a curated gallery and tool for discovering font pairings, especially for Google Fonts. It helps designers find and preview harmonious combinations for web, print, and branding, streamlining the typography process.
description: FontPair is a curated gallery and tool for discovering font pairings, especially for Google Fonts. It helps designers find and preview harmonious combinations for web, print, and branding, streamlining the typography process. Discover and test free font pairings using Google Fonts. Browse 1,000+ curated combinations. Preview with your content and save favorites. Curated Pairings: Browse high-quality font combinations. Live Preview: Test pairings with your own text. Filter by Category: Serif, sans-serif, display, and more. Google Fonts Integration: Easy to use on web projects.
